title: Proactive Intelligence — Watch Movement, Not Just Snapshots
summary: YTIntel now pushes further toward the core paid-product promise: open the workspace and get one evidence-backed production decision, a ranked opportunity feed, real before-and-after video movement, easier competitor setup and automatic stale-data refresh while the app is running.
discord_changes: Added Make This Next: one top production lead with channel-relative evidence, cross-channel receipts, longitudinal snapshots and a direct path into Deep Analyse / Packaging / production.
Added a unified Opportunity Feed plus per-video longitudinal tracking so YTIntel can distinguish observed movement from a one-off view count instead of pretending a snapshot is momentum.
Added automatic competitor discovery, auto-refresh-on-open and optional browser opportunity alerts so the workspace gets useful faster and is easier to return to repeatedly.
changes: Added Make This Next to the top of the creator workspace. Verified channel-relative leads are explicitly separated from leads that still need baseline verification.

Added visible evidence receipts for opportunity score, channel-relative breakout evidence, observed movement and cross-channel replication. Scores remain decision aids, not predictions of views, CTR or retention.

Added a unified Opportunity Feed that combines saved niche Radar evidence and tracked-competitor results, with evidence-based states such as Breaking Out, Rising, Priority, Repeating, Watch, Verify and Cooling.
Added longitudinal local video histories. YTIntel preserves up to 40 observed points per video across repeat Radar and Watchtower snapshots so movement requires a real before-and-after observation.

Added automatic competitor discovery inside workspace setup. Enter a niche and YTIntel proposes relevant channels from existing Radar evidence or fresh niche discovery, then the user chooses the actual watchlist.
Added Auto-refresh on open. When enabled, YTIntel refreshes stale workspace intelligence after six hours, but only while the app is open; this is not a background scheduler or push service.
Added optional browser opportunity alerts after explicit notification permission. Alerts are generated while YTIntel is running and are not represented as background push notifications.
Added a serializable Radar persistence fallback so a rendered Radar scan is not silently lost when cross-channel cluster objects cannot be stored directly.
Updated the PWA cache and installed-app metadata for the new opportunity-first workflow.
Preserved Always-On analysis, winner-vs-control validation, channel-relative evidence, originality guardrails, Idea Vault and Creator Loop small-sample warnings.
why_it_matters: The product becomes more defensible when it does not merely answer a research query once. v0.25 starts building the repeated-use intelligence loop: remember the market, remember each video's observed trajectory, reduce setup work, surface one decision and make the next visit more useful than the previous one.
